result.topic_en: Euler applies his general formula for the height due to the efflux velocity, with friction, to two specific pipe configurations: a first case in §97 and a second case referred to §39 in §98. He substitutes exponential friction factors to obtain explicit expressions for v.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 375
97. His poſitis pro primo caſu habebimus:
$\mathfrak{A}=1$; $A=\frac{a}{f}$; $\mathfrak{B}=e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}}$, $B=\frac{1-\mathfrak{B}}{\alpha}$; $\mathfrak{C}=e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}}$ et $C=\frac{1-\mathfrak{C}}{\alpha}$;
vnde celeritas effluxus debita erit altitudinis $v$, vt ſit
$$v=\frac{a\mathfrak{B}\mathfrak{C}+\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-\mathfrak{B})\mathfrak{C}g\cos.\zeta-\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-\mathfrak{C})h-(1-\mathfrak{B}\mathfrak{C})\mathfrak{l}}{1-(1-\mathfrak{B})\mathfrak{C}\mathfrak{g}-(1-\mathfrak{C})\mathfrak{h}}$$
ſeu ſubſtitutis valoribus aſſumtis:
$$v=\frac{e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}a+\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}})e^{\frac{\alpha b}{h}}g\cos.\zeta-\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}})h-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}-\frac{c}{h}})\mathfrak{l}}{1-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}})e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}}\mathfrak{g}-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}})\mathfrak{h}}$$
ſiue
$$v=\frac{e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}(a-\frac{1}{\alpha}g\cos.\zeta+l)+e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}}(\frac{1}{\alpha}g\cos.\zeta+\frac{1}{\alpha}h)-\frac{1}{\alpha}h-\mathfrak{l}}{1-\mathfrak{h}-e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}}(\mathfrak{g}-\mathfrak{h})+e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}\mathfrak{g}}$$
98. Pro altero vero caſu, ad §. 39. relato, habebimus:
$\mathfrak{A}=1$; $Af=a$; $\mathfrak{B}=e^{\frac{-\alpha b\cos.\zeta}{g}}$; $\cos.\zeta=1$; $g=g$; $\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{g}$; et $B=\frac{1-\mathfrak{B}}{\alpha}$
Tum $\mathfrak{C}=e^{\frac{-\alpha b\sin.\zeta}{g}}$; $\cos.\eta=0$; $h=g$; $\mathfrak{h}=\mathfrak{g}$; et $C=\frac{1-\mathfrak{C}}{\alpha}$;
atque $\mathfrak{D}=e^{\frac{-1c}{h}}$ [?]; $\cos.\theta=-1$; $i=h$; $\mathfrak{i}=\mathfrak{h}$; et $D=\frac{1-\mathfrak{D}}{\alpha}$;
quibus valoribus ſubſtitutis prodibit altitudo celeritati effluxus debita:
$$v=\frac{(l+a)e^{\frac{-\alpha b\cos.\zeta}{g}-\frac{\alpha b\sin.\zeta}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}+\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b\cos.\zeta}{g}})e^{-\frac{\alpha b\sin.\zeta}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}g-\frac{1}{\alpha}(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}})h-\mathfrak{l}}{1-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b\cos.\zeta}{g}})e^{\frac{-\alpha b\sin.\zeta}{g}-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}\mathfrak{g}-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha b\sin.\zeta}{g}})e^{-\frac{\alpha c}{h}}\mathfrak{g}-(1-e^{\frac{-\alpha c}{h}})\mathfrak{h}}$$
ſiue
